curiosities: It was the first console with programmable ROM cartridges.
Jerry Lawson, one of the first Black engineers in the games industry, led its development.
Its 'Hold' button made it the first console that could pause a game.
Its controllers can be twisted, pushed, pulled and moved in eight directions.
bestsellers: Videocart-1: Tic-Tac-Toe & Shooting Gallery & Doodle & Quadra-Doodle
